fact: The health ministry's piece on the World Bank identification mission for the MPA Sante & Emploi project names DHIS2, OpenLMIS, e-SENI and other platforms and makes automated exchange between DHIS2, OpenLMIS and the others a national priority; OpenLMIS is deployed in 5 national warehouses, 7 regions and 26 districts.
title: DOSSIER SPÉCIAL — MPA SANTÉ & EMPLOI (SUITE)
publisher: Ministère de la santé et de la Population
